contents.text: This is the first of the four. A guest asks for a sea view and says they're bringing a dog. The agent opens the one room that takes dogs, the garden room, so the guest lands on the right booking.

choices.label: On to: It shows the booking as a card
choices.why: The second of the four, how the request comes back to you.
